title: Reports
seo: eBay seller reports on sales and fees
meta: A plain eBay report on sales, fees, returns and top items, with a short list of next steps. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay reports that explain your sales and fees
overview: We pull your eBay sales, payouts, fee and return data into a single report with plain explanations. You see revenue, eBay fees, ad fees, shipping costs, returns and what you keep, plus best and slowest items, seller level figures and conversion. Each section ends with a sentence on what it means and what to try. We use only the data in your own account, so there is no guessing from outside.

pkgs.blurb: One month of sales, fees and returns explained.
Two months compared, with seller level and ad detail.
Three months of trends with a dashboard and review call.

faq: Where do you get the figures?
From your own eBay Seller Hub reports and transaction downloads. We do not pull data from third parties and we never need your bank login.
Can you include my cost of goods?
Yes, if you send a cost sheet, we show real profit per item and category. Without it, the report shows net sales after eBay fees and shipping, and says so on the page.
Will you tell me why my seller level changed?
We show the numbers behind it, like late shipments, cases and defects, and point out the few orders that caused most of the damage so you know what to fix first.
This is a one-off report at a fixed price. A repeating monthly report can be quoted separately, in the same layout, so you can compare month to month.
